We should call this function with case_number="CA123456", county="San Diego" or maybe "聖地牙哥縣"? The function expects county string; we can pass "San Diego" or "聖地牙哥縣". The user used Chinese characters for county name. But the function might expect English county names? It says "The county in which the crime occurred." Could be either. We'll use "San Diego" because it's likely the function expects English. Or we could pass "聖地牙哥縣" but risk mismatch. Let's use "San Diego".
